newsitem.title: USA: Magnum Hunter gets new $145 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Magnum Hunter gets new $145 mln credit line.

text.p: Magnum Hunter Resources Inc said its banks boosted the company's credit facility to $145 million from $55 million.
The facility is conditioned on the company's April 30 closing of its Permian Basin Properties transaction with units of Burlington Resources Inc, the company said.

The new credit line is from Wells Fargo Bank, Banque Paribas, First National Bank of North Carolina and Bankers Trust Co. It continues to give the company the flexibility to choose a range of either LIBOR or prime-based interest rate options, Magnum added.
